title: Sunflower Punk Dancer
description: Four nearly identical poses of a stylized female character with spiky black and yellow hair, wearing a sunflower-themed punk outfit with a yellow and black dress, corset, long gloves, and platform boots. The character is shown mid-stride against a solid bright green background, with one hand raised in a peace sign.
prompt: A stylized anime girl with spiky black hair adorned with large yellow sunflowers, wearing a yellow ruffled dress with black sunflower patterns, black corset, long black and yellow gloves, and tall yellow platform boots with black laces. She has a black tail with a sunflower at the end. The character is shown in four repeated walking poses with one hand making a peace sign, against a solid vibrant green background, clean vector art style with bold black outlines
